stories.title: 🪙 Isaia 48
summaryBullets: "Hear this, O house of Jacob, who are called by the name of Israel, and who came from the waters of Judah, who swear by the name of il SIGNORE and confess the God of Israel, but not in truth or right" (48:1).
"For they call themselves after the holy city, and stay themselves on the God of Israel; il SIGNORE of hosts is His name" (48:2).
"The former things I declared of old; they went out from My mouth, and I announced them; then suddenly I did them, and they came to pass" (48:3).
"Because I know that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew and your forehead brass" (48:4).
"I declared them to you from of old, before they came to pass I announced them to you, lest you should say, 'My idol did them, my carved image and my metal image commanded them'" (48:5).
"You have heard; now see all this; and will you not declare it? From this time forth I announce to you new things, hidden things that you have not known" (48:6).
"They are created now, not long ago; before today you have never heard of them, lest you should say, 'Behold, I knew them'" (48:7).
"You have never heard, you have never known, from of old your ear has not been opened. For I knew that you would surely deal treacherously, and that from before birth you were called a rebel" (48:8).
"For My name's sake I defer My anger; for the sake of My praise I restrain it for you, that I may not cut you off" (48:9).
"Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver; I have tried you in the furnace of affliction" (48:10).
"For My own sake, for My own sake, I do it, for how should My name be profaned? My glory I will not give to another" (48:11).
"Listen to Me, O Jacob, and Israel, whom I called! I am He; I am the first, and I am the last" (48:12).
"My hand laid the foundation of the earth, and My right hand spread out the heavens; when I call to them, they stand forth together" (48:13).
Adunatevi tutti quanti e ascoltate! Chi di voi ha annunciato queste cose? Colui che il Signore ama eseguirà il suo volere contro Babilonia, alzerà il suo braccio contro i Caldei. (48:14).
"I, even I, have spoken and called him; I have brought him, and he will prosper in his way" (48:15).
Avvicinatevi a me, ascoltate questo: fin dal principio io non ho parlato in segreto; quando questi fatti avvenivano, io ero presente; ora, il Signore, Dio, mi manda con il suo Spirito. (48:16).
Thus says il SIGNORE, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: "Io sono il SIGNORE vostro Dio, who teaches you to profit, who leads you in the way you should go" (48:17).
"Oh that you had paid attention to My commandments! Then your peace would have been like a river, and your righteousness like the waves of the sea" (48:18).
"Your offspring would have been like the sand, and your descendants like its grains; their name would never be cut off or destroyed from before Me" (48:19).

Uscite da Babilonia, fuggite lontano dai Caldei! Con voce gioiosa annunciatelo, proclamatelo, diffondetelo fino alle estremità della terra! Dite: «Il Signore ha riscattato il suo servo Giacobbe». (48:20).
Essi non hanno avuto sete quando egli li ha condotti attraverso i deserti; egli ha fatto scaturire per essi acqua dalla roccia; ha spaccato la roccia e ne è colata acqua. (48:21).
"There is no peace," says il SIGNORE, "for the wicked" (48:22).

stories.title: 🕯️ Isaia 49
summaryBullets: Isole, ascoltatemi! Popoli lontani, state attenti! Il Signore mi ha chiamato fin dal seno materno, ha pronunciato il mio nome fin dal grembo di mia madre. (49:1).
He made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of His hand He hid me; He made me a polished arrow; in His quiver He hid me away (49:2).
And He said to me, "You are My servant, Israel, in whom I will be glorified" (49:3).
But I said, "I have labored in vain; I have spent my strength for nothing and vanity; yet surely my right is with il SIGNORE, and my recompense with my God" (49:4).

Ora parla il Signore che mi ha formato fin dal grembo materno per essere suo servo, per ricondurgli Giacobbe, per raccogliere intorno a lui Israele; io sono onorato agli occhi del Signore, il mio Dio è la mia forza. (49:5).

Egli dice: «È troppo poco che tu sia mio servo per rialzare le tribù di Giacobbe e per ricondurre gli scampati d’Israele; voglio fare di te la luce delle nazioni, lo strumento della mia salvezza fino alle estremità della terra». (49:6).

Thus says il SIGNORE, the Redeemer of Israel and his Holy One, to one deeply despised, abhorred by the nation, the servant of rulers: "Kings shall see and arise; princes, and they shall prostrate themselves; because of il SIGNORE, who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you" (49:7).

Così parla il Signore: «Nel tempo della grazia io ti esaudirò, nel giorno della salvezza ti aiuterò; ti preserverò e farò di te l’alleanza del popolo, per rialzare il paese, per rimetterli in possesso delle eredità devastate, (49:8).
per dire ai prigionieri: “Uscite”, e a quelli che sono nelle tenebre: “Mostratevi!” Essi pasceranno lungo le vie e troveranno il loro pascolo su tutte le alture; (49:9).
They shall not hunger or thirst, neither scorching wind nor sun shall strike them, for He who has pity on them will lead them, and by springs of water will guide them (49:10).
And I will make all My mountains a road, and My highways shall be raised up (49:11).
Guardate! Questi vengono da lontano; ecco, questi altri vengono da settentrione e da occidente, e questi dal paese dei Sinim». (49:12).
Sing for joy, O heavens, and exult, O earth; break forth, O mountains, into singing! For il SIGNORE has comforted His people and will have compassion on His afflicted (49:13).
But Zion said, "The LORD has forsaken me; my Lord has forgotten me" (49:14).
"Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should have no compassion on figlio di her womb? Even these may forget, yet I will not forget you" (49:15).
"Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of My hands; your walls are continually before Me" (49:16).
Your builders make haste; your destroyers and those who laid you waste go out from you (49:17).

Volgi lo sguardo intorno e guarda: essi si radunano tutti e vengono da te. «Com’è vero che io vivo», dice il Signore, «tu ti rivestirai di essi come di un ornamento, te ne adornerai come una sposa. (49:18).
"Surely your waste and your desolate places and your devastated land—surely now you will be too narrow for your inhabitants, and those who swallowed you up will be far away" (49:19).
The children born in the time of your bereavement will yet say in your ears: "The place is too narrow for me; make room for me to dwell in" (49:20).
Then you will say in your heart: "Who has borne me these? I was bereaved and barren, exiled and put away, but who has brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; from where have these come?" (49:21).

Così parla il Signore, Dio: «Ecco, io alzerò la mia mano verso le nazioni, innalzerò la mia bandiera verso i popoli, ed essi ti ricondurranno i tuoi figli in braccio, ti riporteranno le tue figlie sulle spalle. (49:22).

I re saranno i tuoi precettori e le loro regine saranno le tue balie; essi si inchineranno davanti a te con la faccia a terra, lambiranno la polvere dei tuoi piedi; tu riconoscerai che io sono il Signore, che coloro che sperano in me non saranno delusi». (49:23).
"Can the prey be taken from the mighty, or the captives of a tyrant be rescued?" (49:24).
Sì, così dice il Signore: «Anche i prigionieri del forte verranno liberati e il bottino del tiranno fuggirà; io combatterò contro chi ti combatte e salverò i tuoi figli. (49:25).

"I will make your oppressors eat their own flesh, and they shall be drunk with their own blood as with wine. Then all flesh shall know that Io sono il SIGNORE your Savior, and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob" (49:26).

stories.title: 🕯️ Isaia 50
summaryBullets: Thus says il SIGNORE: "Where is your mother's certificate of divorce, with which I sent her away? Or which of My creditors is it to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities you were sold, and for your transgressions your mother was sent away" (50:1).

"Why, when I came, was there no man; why, when I called, was there no one to answer? Is My hand shortened, that it cannot redeem? Or have I no power to deliver? Behold, by My rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a desert" (50:2).
"I clothe the heavens with blackness and make sackcloth their covering" (50:3).

The Lord GOD has given me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain with a word him who is weary. Morning by morning He awakens; He awakens my ear to hear as those who are taught (50:4).
The Lord GOD has opened my ear, and I was not rebellious; I turned not backward (50:5).
I gave my back to those who strike, and my cheeks to those who pull out the beard; I hid not my face from disgrace and spitting (50:6).
But the Lord GOD helps me; therefore I have not been disgraced; therefore I have set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be put to shame (50:7).
He who vindicates me is near. Who will contend with me? Let us stand up together. Who is my adversary? Let him come near to me (50:8).
Behold, the Lord GOD helps me; who will declare me guilty? Behold, all of them will wear out like a garment; the moth will eat them up (50:9).
Who among you fears il SIGNORE and obeys the voice of His servant? Let him who walks in darkness and has no light trust in the name of il SIGNORE and rely on his God (50:10).

Behold, all you who kindle a fire, who equip yourselves with burning torches! Walk by the light of your fire, and by the torches that you have kindled! This you will have from My hand: you shall lie down in torment (50:11).

stories.title: 🛤️ Isaia 51
summaryBullets: «Ascoltatemi, voi che perseguite la giustizia, che cercate il Signore! Considerate la roccia da cui foste tagliati, la buca della cava da cui foste cavati. (51:1).
"Look to Abraham your father and to Sarah who bore you; for he was but one when I called him, that I might bless him and multiply him" (51:2).

"For il SIGNORE comforts Zion; He comforts all her waste places and makes her wilderness like Eden, her desert like the garden of il SIGNORE; joy and gladness will be found in her, thanksgiving and the voice of song" (51:3).
"Give attention to Me, My people, and give ear to Me, My nation; for a law will go out from Me, and I will set My justice for a light to the peoples" (51:4).
"My righteousness draws near, My salvation has gone out, and My arms will judge the peoples; the coastlands hope for Me, and for My arm they wait" (51:5).

Alzate i vostri occhi al cielo e abbassateli sulla terra! I cieli infatti si dilegueranno come fumo, la terra invecchierà come un vestito; anche i suoi abitanti moriranno; ma la mia salvezza durerà in eterno, la mia giustizia non verrà mai meno. (51:6).
"Listen to Me, you who know righteousness, the people in whose heart is My law; fear not the reproach of man, nor be dismayed at their revilings" (51:7).
Infatti la tignola li divorerà come un vestito, la tarma li roderà come la lana; ma la mia giustizia rimarrà in eterno, la mia salvezza per ogni epoca». (51:8).
"Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of il SIGNORE; awake, as in days of old, the generations of long ago. Was it not You who cut Rahab in pieces, who pierced the dragon?" (51:9).
Non sei tu che prosciugasti il mare, le acque del grande abisso, che facesti delle profondità del mare una via per il passaggio dei redenti? (51:10).
I riscattati del Signore torneranno, verranno con canti di gioia a Sion; letizia eterna coronerà il loro capo, otterranno felicità e gioia; il dolore e il gemito fuggiranno. (51:11).
"I, I am He who comforts you; who are you that you are afraid of man who dies, of figlio di man who is made like grass" (51:12).

Hai dimenticato il Signore che ti ha fatto, che ha disteso i cieli e fondato la terra? Tu tremi continuamente, tutto il giorno, davanti al furore dell’oppressore, quando si prepara a distruggere. Ma dov’è il furore dell’oppressore? (51:13).
"He who is bowed down shall speedily be released; he shall not die and go down to the pit, neither shall his bread be lacking" (51:14).
"Io sono il SIGNORE vostro Dio, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar—il SIGNORE of hosts is His name" (51:15).
Io ho messo le mie parole nella tua bocca e ti ho coperto con l’ombra della mia mano per spiegare nuovi cieli e fondare una nuova terra, per dire a Sion: “Tu sei il mio popolo”». (51:16).
Risvègliati, risvègliati, àlzati, Gerusalemme, che hai bevuto dalla mano del Signore il calice, la coppa di stordimento, e l’hai succhiata sino in fondo! (51:17).
Fra tutti i figli da lei partoriti non c’è nessuno che la guidi; fra tutti i figli da lei allevati non c’è nessuno che la prenda per mano. (51:18).
These two things have happened to you—who will console you?—devastation and destruction, famine and sword; who will comfort you? (51:19).
Your sons have fainted; they lie at the head of every street like an antelope in a net; they are full of the wrath of il SIGNORE, the rebuke of your God (51:20).
Therefore hear this, you who are afflicted, who are drunk, but not with wine (51:21).
Thus says your Lord, il SIGNORE, your God who pleads the cause of His people: "Behold, I have taken from your hand the cup of staggering; the bowl of My wrath you shall drink no more" (51:22).

"And I will put it into the hand of your tormentors, who have said to you, 'Bow down, that we may pass over'; and you have made your back like the ground and like the street for them to pass over" (51:23).

stories.title: 🛤️ Isaia 52
summaryBullets: Awake, awake, put on your strength, O Zion; put on your beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city; for there shall no more come into you the uncircumcised and the unclean (52:1).
Shake yourself from the dust and arise; be seated, O Jerusalem; loose the bonds from your neck, O captive daughter of Zion (52:2).
For thus says il SIGNORE: "You were sold for nothing, and you shall be redeemed without money" (52:3).
Poiché così parla il Signore, Dio: «Il mio popolo discese già in Egitto per abitarvi; poi l’Assiro lo oppresse senza motivo. (52:4).

"Now therefore what have I here," declares il SIGNORE, "seeing that My people are taken away for nothing? Their rulers wail," declares il SIGNORE, "and continually all the day My name is despised" (52:5).
"Therefore My people shall know My name. Therefore in that day they shall know that it is I who speak; here I am" (52:6).
How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace, who brings good news of happiness, who publishes salvation, who says to Zion, "Your God reigns" (52:7).
The voice of your watchmen—they lift up their voice; together they sing for joy; for eye to eye they see the return of il SIGNORE to Zion (52:8).
Break forth together into singing, you waste places of Jerusalem, for il SIGNORE has comforted His people; He has redeemed Jerusalem (52:9).
Il Signore ha rivelato il suo braccio santo agli occhi di tutte le nazioni; tutte le estremità della terra vedranno la salvezza del nostro Dio. (52:10).
Depart, depart, go out from there; touch no unclean thing; go out from the midst of her; purify yourselves, you who bear the vessels of il SIGNORE (52:11).
Voi infatti non partirete in fretta, non ve ne andrete come chi fugge; poiché il Signore camminerà davanti a voi, il Dio d’Israele sarà la vostra retroguardia. (52:12).
Ecco, il mio servo prospererà, sarà innalzato, esaltato, reso sommamente eccelso. (52:13).
Come molti, vedendolo, sono rimasti sbigottiti (tanto era disfatto il suo sembiante al punto da non sembrare più un uomo, e il suo aspetto al punto da non sembrare più un figlio d’uomo), (52:14).
So shall he sprinkle many nations. Kings shall shut their mouths because of him, for that which has not been told them they see, and that which they have not heard they understand (52:15).

stories.title: ✝️ Isaia 53
summaryBullets: Who has believed what he has heard from us? And to whom has the arm of il SIGNORE been revealed? (53:1).
For he grew up before Him like a young plant, and like a root out of dry ground; he had no form or majesty that we should look at him, and no beauty that we should desire him (53:2).

Disprezzato e abbandonato dagli uomini, uomo di dolore, familiare con la sofferenza, pari a colui davanti al quale ciascuno si nasconde la faccia, era spregiato, e noi non ne facemmo stima alcuna. (53:3).
Surely he has borne our griefs and carried our sorrows; yet we esteemed him stricken, smitten by God, and afflicted (53:4).

Egli è stato trafitto a causa delle nostre trasgressioni, stroncato a causa delle nostre iniquità; il castigo, per cui abbiamo pace, è caduto su di lui e mediante le sue lividure noi siamo stati guariti. (53:5).
All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned—every one—to his own way; and il SIGNORE has laid on him the iniquity of us all (53:6).
Maltrattato, si lasciò umiliare e non aprì la bocca. Come l’agnello condotto al mattatoio, come la pecora muta davanti a chi la tosa, egli non aprì la bocca. (53:7).
Dopo l’arresto e la condanna fu tolto di mezzo; e tra quelli della sua generazione chi rifletté che egli era strappato dalla terra dei viventi e colpito a causa dei peccati del mio popolo? (53:8).
And they made his grave with the wicked and with a rich man in his death, although he had done no violence, and there was no deceit in his mouth (53:9).

Yet it was the will of il SIGNORE to crush him; He has put him to grief; when his soul makes an offering for guilt, he shall see his offspring; he shall prolong his days; the will of il SIGNORE shall prosper in his hand (53:10).
Out of the anguish of his soul he shall see and be satisfied; by his knowledge shall the righteous one, My servant, make many to be accounted righteous, and he shall bear their iniquities (53:11).

Therefore I will divide him a portion with the many, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong, because he poured out his soul to death and was numbered with the transgressors; yet he bore the sin of many, and makes intercession for the transgressors (53:12).

stories.title: 🌧️ Isaia 54
summaryBullets: «Esulta, o sterile, tu che non partorivi! Da’ in grida di gioia e rallègrati, tu che non provavi doglie di parto! Poiché i figli dell’abbandonata saranno più numerosi dei figli di colei che ha marito», dice il Signore. (54:1).
"Enlarge the place of your tent, and let the curtains of your habitations be stretched out; do not hold back; lengthen your cords and strengthen your stakes" (54:2).
Poiché ti spanderai a destra e a sinistra; la tua discendenza possederà le nazioni e popolerà le città deserte. (54:3).

"Fear not, for you will not be ashamed; be not confounded, for you will not be disgraced; for you will forget the shame of your youth, and the reproach of your widowhood you will remember no more" (54:4).
Poiché il tuo Creatore è il tuo sposo; il suo nome è: il Signore degli eserciti. Il tuo Redentore è il Santo d’Israele, che sarà chiamato Dio di tutta la terra. (54:5).
"For il SIGNORE has called you like a wife deserted and grieved in spirit, like a wife of youth when she is cast off," says your God (54:6).
"For a brief moment I deserted you, but with great compassion I will gather you" (54:7).
"In overflowing anger for a moment I hid My face from you, but with everlasting love I will have compassion on you," says il SIGNORE, your Redeemer (54:8).
"This is like the days of Noah to Me: as I swore that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth, so I have sworn that I will not be angry with you, and will not rebuke you" (54:9).
Anche se i monti si allontanassero e i colli fossero rimossi, l’amore mio non si allontanerà da te, né il mio patto di pace sarà rimosso», dice il Signore, che ha pietà di te. (54:10).
"O afflicted one, storm-tossed and not comforted, behold, I will set your stones in antimony, and lay your foundations with sapphires" (54:11).
"I will make your pinnacles of agate, your gates of carbuncles, and all your wall of precious stones" (54:12).
Tutti i tuoi figli saranno discepoli del Signore e grande sarà la pace dei tuoi figli. (54:13).
Tu sarai stabilita fermamente mediante la giustizia; sarai lontana dall’oppressione, perché non avrai niente da temere, e dalla rovina, perché non si accosterà a te. (54:14).
"If anyone stirs up strife, it is not from Me; whoever stirs up strife with you shall fall because of you" (54:15).
"Behold, I have created the smith who blows the fire of coals and produces a weapon for its purpose. I have also created the ravager to destroy" (54:16).

Nessun’arma fabbricata contro di te riuscirà; ogni lingua che sorgerà in giudizio contro di te, tu la condannerai. Questa è l’eredità dei servi del Signore, la giusta ricompensa che verrà loro da me», dice il Signore. (54:17).

stories.title: 🌧️ Isaia 55
summaryBullets: "Come, everyone who thirsts, come to the waters; and he who has no money, come, buy and eat! Come, buy wine and milk without money and without price" (55:1).
"Why do you spend your money for that which is not bread, and your labor for that which does not satisfy? Listen diligently to Me, and eat what is good, and delight yourselves in rich food" (55:2).
"Incline your ear, and come to Me; hear, that your soul may live; and I will make with you an everlasting covenant, My steadfast, sure love for David" (55:3).
Ecco, io l’ho dato come testimonio ai popoli, come principe e governatore dei popoli. (55:4).
Ecco, tu chiamerai nazioni che non conosci, e nazioni che non ti conoscono accorreranno a te a motivo del Signore, del tuo Dio, del Santo d’Israele, perché egli ti avrà glorificato». (55:5).
"Seek il SIGNORE while He may be found; call upon Him while He is near" (55:6).
"Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts; let him return to il SIGNORE, that He may have compassion on him, and to our God, for He will abundantly pardon" (55:7).
"For My thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways My ways," declares il SIGNORE (55:8).
"For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are My ways higher than your ways and My thoughts than your thoughts" (55:9).

Come la pioggia e la neve scendono dal cielo e non vi ritornano senza aver annaffiato la terra, senza averla fecondata e fatta germogliare, affinché dia seme al seminatore e pane da mangiare, (55:10).
"So shall My word be that goes out from My mouth; it shall not return to Me empty, but it shall accomplish that which I purpose, and shall succeed in the thing for which I sent it" (55:11).
Sì, voi partirete con gioia e sarete ricondotti in pace; i monti e i colli proromperanno in grida di gioia davanti a voi, tutti gli alberi della campagna batteranno le mani. (55:12).
Nel luogo del pruno si eleverà il cipresso, nel luogo del rovo crescerà il mirto; ciò sarà per il Signore un motivo di gloria, un monumento perenne che non sarà distrutto». (55:13).

stories.title: 🌍 Isaia 56
summaryBullets: Thus says il SIGNORE: "Keep justice, and do righteousness, for soon My salvation will come, and My righteousness be revealed" (56:1).
"Blessed is the man who does this, and figlio di man who holds it fast, who keeps the Sabbath, not profaning it, and keeps his hand from doing any evil" (56:2).
Let not the foreigner who has joined himself to il SIGNORE say, "The LORD will surely separate me from His people"; and let not the eunuch say, "Behold, I am a dry tree" (56:3).
For thus says il SIGNORE: "To the eunuchs who keep My Sabbaths, who choose the things that please Me and hold fast My covenant" (56:4).
"I will give in My house and within My walls a monument and a name better than sons and daughters; I will give them an everlasting name that shall not be cut off" (56:5).

"And the foreigners who join themselves to il SIGNORE, to minister to Him, to love the name of il SIGNORE, and to be His servants, everyone who keeps the Sabbath and does not profane it, and holds fast My covenant" (56:6).

"These I will bring to My holy mountain, and make them joyful in My house of prayer; their olocaustos and their sacrifices will be accepted on My altar; for My house shall be called a house of prayer for all peoples" (56:7).
The Lord GOD, who gathers the outcasts of Israel, declares, "I will gather yet others to him besides those already gathered" (56:8).
O voi tutte, bestie dei campi, venite a mangiare, venite, o voi tutte, bestie della foresta! (56:9).
His watchmen are blind; they are all without knowledge; they are all silent dogs; they cannot bark, dreaming, lying down, loving to slumber (56:10).
The dogs have a mighty appetite; they never have enough. But they are shepherds who have no understanding; they have all turned to their own way, each to his own gain, one and all (56:11).
"Come," they say, "let me get wine; let us fill ourselves with strong drink; and tomorrow will be like this day, great beyond measure" (56:12).

stories.title: 🌍 Isaia 57
summaryBullets: The righteous man perishes, and no one lays it to heart; devout men are taken away, while no one understands. For the righteous man is taken away from calamity (57:1).
He enters into peace; they rest in their beds who walk in their uprightness (57:2).
«Ma voi, avvicinatevi qua, figli della incantatrice, discendenza dell’adultero e della prostituta! (57:3).
Whom are you mocking? Against whom do you open your mouth wide and stick out your tongue? Are you not children of transgression, the offspring of deceit (57:4).
voi, che v’infiammate fra i terebinti sotto ogni albero verdeggiante, che scannate i figli nelle valli sotto i crepacci delle rocce? (57:5).

Among the smooth stones of the valley is your portion; they, they, are your lot; to them you have poured out a libazione, you have brought a offerta di cereali. Shall I relent for these things? (57:6).
On a high and lofty mountain you have set your bed, and there you went up to offer sacrifice (57:7).

Behind the door and the doorpost you have set up your memorial; for, deserting Me, you have uncovered your bed, you have gone up to it, you have made it wide; and you have made a covenant for yourself with them, you have loved their bed, you have looked on nakedness (57:8).
You journeyed to the king with oil and multiplied your perfumes; you sent your envoys far off, and sent down even to Sheol (57:9).
You were wearied with the length of your way, but you did not say, "It is hopeless"; you found new life for your strength, and so you were not faint (57:10).
"Whom did you dread and fear, so that you lied, and did not remember Me, did not lay it to heart? Have I not held My peace, even for a long time, and you do not fear Me?" (57:11).
"I will declare your righteousness and your deeds, but they will not profit you" (57:12).

"When you cry out, let your collection of idols deliver you! The wind will carry them all off, a breath will take them away. But he who takes refuge in Me shall possess the land and shall inherit My holy mountain" (57:13).
And it shall be said, "Build up, build up, prepare the way, remove every obstruction from My people's way" (57:14).

Infatti così parla Colui che è l’Alto, l’eccelso, che abita l’eternità e che si chiama il Santo: «Io dimoro nel luogo eccelso e santo, ma sto vicino a chi è oppresso e umile di spirito per ravvivare lo spirito degli umili, per ravvivare il cuore degli oppressi. (57:15).
Io infatti non voglio contendere per sempre né serbare l’ira in eterno, affinché gli spiriti, le anime che io ho fatte, non vengano meno davanti a me. (57:16).
Per l’iniquità della sua cupidigia io mi sono adirato e l’ho colpito; mi sono nascosto, mi sono indignato; ma egli, ribelle, ha seguito la via del suo cuore. (57:17).
"I have seen his ways, but I will heal him; I will lead him and restore comfort to him and his mourners" (57:18).
Io metterò la lode sulle sue labbra. Pace, pace a chi è lontano e a chi è vicino», dice il Signore, «io lo guarirò!» (57:19).
But the wicked are like the tossing sea; for it cannot be quiet, and its waters toss up mire and dirt (57:20).
"There is no peace," says my God, "for the wicked" (57:21).

stories.title: 🕯️ Isaia 58
summaryBullets: "Cry aloud; do not hold back; lift up your voice like a trumpet; declare to My people their transgression, to the house of Jacob their sins" (58:1).

"Yet they seek Me daily and delight to know My ways, as if they were a nation that did righteousness and did not forsake the judgment of their God; they ask of Me righteous judgments; they delight to draw near to God" (58:2).

"'Why have we fasted, and You see it not? Why have we humbled ourselves, and You take no knowledge of it?' Behold, in the day of your fast you seek your own pleasure, and oppress all your workers" (58:3).
"Behold, you fast only to quarrel and to fight and to hit with a wicked fist. Fasting like yours this day will not make your voice to be heard on high" (58:4).

"Is such the fast that I choose, a day for a person to humble himself? Is it to bow down his head like a reed, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him? Will you call this a fast, and a day acceptable to il SIGNORE?" (58:5).
"Is not this the fast that I choose: to loose the bonds of wickedness, to undo the straps of the yoke, to let the oppressed go free, and to break every yoke?" (58:6).
"Is it not to share your bread with the hungry and bring the homeless poor into your house; when you see the naked, to cover him, and not to hide yourself from your own flesh?" (58:7).
"Then shall your light break forth like the dawn, and your healing shall spring up speedily; your righteousness shall go before you; the glory of il SIGNORE shall be your rear guard" (58:8).
Allora chiamerai e il Signore ti risponderà; griderai ed egli dirà: “Eccomi!” Se tu togli di mezzo a te il giogo, il dito accusatore e il parlare con menzogna, (58:9).
se tu supplisci ai bisogni dell’affamato e sazi l’afflitto, la tua luce spunterà nelle tenebre e la tua notte oscura sarà come il mezzogiorno; (58:10).

"And il SIGNORE will guide you continually and satisfy your desire in scorched places and make your bones strong; and you shall be like a watered garden, like a spring of water, whose waters do not fail" (58:11).

I tuoi ricostruiranno sulle antiche rovine; tu rialzerai le fondamenta gettate da molte età e sarai chiamato il riparatore delle brecce, il restauratore dei sentieri per rendere abitabile il paese. (58:12).

Se tu trattieni il piede dal violare il sabato, facendo i tuoi affari nel mio santo giorno, se chiami il sabato una delizia e venerabile ciò che è sacro al Signore, se onori quel giorno anziché seguire le tue vie e fare i tuoi affari e discutere le tue cause, (58:13).
allora troverai la tua delizia nel Signore; io ti farò cavalcare sulle alture del paese, ti nutrirò della eredità di Giacobbe tuo padre», poiché la bocca del Signore ha parlato. (58:14).

stories.title: 🕯️ Isaia 59
summaryBullets: Behold, il SIGNORE's hand is not shortened, that it cannot save, or His ear dull, that it cannot hear (59:1).
But your iniquities have made a separation between you and your God, and your sins have hidden His face from you so that He does not hear (59:2).
For your hands are defiled with blood and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies; your tongue mutters wickedness (59:3).
No one enters suit justly; no one goes to law honestly; they rely on empty pleas, they speak lies, they conceive mischief and give birth to iniquity (59:4).
They hatch adders' eggs; they weave the spider's web; he who eats their eggs dies, and from one that is crushed a viper is hatched (59:5).
Their webs will not serve as clothing; men will not cover themselves with what they make. Their works are works of iniquity, and deeds of violence are in their hands (59:6).
Their feet run to evil, and they are swift to shed innocent blood; their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; desolation and destruction are in their highways (59:7).
The way of peace they do not know, and there is no justice in their paths; they have made their roads crooked; no one who treads on them knows peace (59:8).
Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness does not overtake us; we hope for light, and behold, darkness, and for brightness, but we walk in gloom (59:9).
Andiamo tastando la parete come i ciechi, andiamo a tastoni come chi non ha occhi; inciampiamo in pieno mezzogiorno come nel crepuscolo, in mezzo all’abbondanza sembriamo dei morti. (59:10).
We all growl like bears; we moan and moan like doves; we hope for justice, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far from us (59:11).
For our transgressions are multiplied before You, and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us, and we know our iniquities (59:12).
Transgressing, and denying il SIGNORE, and turning back from following our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart lying words (59:13).
Justice is turned back, and righteousness stands far away; for truth has stumbled in the public squares, and uprightness cannot enter (59:14).
La verità è scomparsa, e chi si allontana dal male si espone a essere spogliato. (59:15).
ha visto che non c’era più un uomo e si è stupito che nessuno intervenisse. Allora il suo braccio gli è venuto in aiuto, la sua giustizia lo ha sorretto; (59:16).
He put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation on His head; He put on garments of vengeance for clothing, and wrapped Himself in zeal as a cloak (59:17).
According to their deeds, so will He repay, wrath to His adversaries, repayment to His enemies; to the coastlands He will render repayment (59:18).
Così si temerà il nome del Signore dall’occidente e la sua gloria dall’oriente; quando l’avversario verrà come una fiumana, lo Spirito del Signore lo metterà in fuga. (59:19).
"And a Redeemer will come to Zion, to those in Jacob who turn from transgression," declares il SIGNORE (59:20).

«Quanto a me», dice il Signore, «questo è il patto che io stabilirò con loro: il mio Spirito che riposa su di te e le mie parole che ho messe nella tua bocca non si allontaneranno mai dalla tua bocca, né dalla bocca della tua discendenza, né dalla bocca della discendenza della tua discendenza», dice il Signore, «da ora e per sempre». (59:21).

stories.title: 🌅 Isaia 60
summaryBullets: "Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of il SIGNORE has risen upon you" (60:1).
"For behold, darkness shall cover the earth, and thick darkness the peoples; but il SIGNORE will arise upon you, and His glory will be seen upon you" (60:2).
"And nations shall come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your rising" (60:3).
"Lift up your eyes all around, and see; they all gather together, they come to you; your sons shall come from afar, and your daughters shall be carried on the hip" (60:4).
Allora guarderai e sarai raggiante, il tuo cuore palpiterà forte e si allargherà, poiché l’abbondanza del mare si volgerà verso di te, la ricchezza delle nazioni verrà da te. (60:5).

"A multitude of camels shall cover you, the young camels of Midian and Ephah; all those from Sheba shall come. They shall bring gold and frankincense, and shall bring good news, the praises of il SIGNORE" (60:6).
"All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered to you; the rams of Nebaioth shall minister to you; they shall come up with acceptance on My altar, and I will beautify My beautiful house" (60:7).
"Who are these that fly like a cloud, and like doves to their windows?" (60:8).

Sono le isole che spereranno in me e avranno alla loro testa le navi di Tarsis, per ricondurre i tuoi figli da lontano con argento e con oro, per onorare il nome del Signore, tuo Dio, del Santo d’Israele, che ti avrà glorificata. (60:9).
"Foreigners shall build up your walls, and their kings shall minister to you; for in My wrath I struck you, but in My favor I have had mercy on you" (60:10).
Le tue porte saranno sempre aperte; non saranno chiuse né giorno né notte, per lasciar entrare in te la ricchezza delle nazioni e i loro re in corteo. (60:11).
Poiché la nazione e il regno che non vorranno servirti, periranno; quelle nazioni saranno completamente distrutte. (60:12).
"The glory of Lebanon shall come to you, the cypress, the plane, and the pine, to beautify the place of My sanctuary, and I will make the place of My feet glorious" (60:13).

I figli di quelli che ti avranno oppressa verranno da te abbassandosi; tutti quelli che ti avranno disprezzata si prostreranno fino alla pianta dei tuoi piedi e ti chiameranno “Città del Signore”, “Sion del Santo d’Israele”. (60:14).
"Whereas you have been forsaken and hated, with no one passing through, I will make you majestic forever, a joy from age to age" (60:15).
Tu popperai il latte delle nazioni, popperai al seno dei re e riconoscerai che io, il Signore, sono il tuo Salvatore, io, il Potente di Giacobbe, sono il tuo Redentore. (60:16).

"Instead of bronze I will bring gold, and instead of iron I will bring silver; instead of wood, bronze, instead of stones, iron. I will make your overseers peace and your taskmasters righteousness" (60:17).
"Violence shall no more be heard in your land, devastation or destruction within your borders; you shall call your walls Salvation, and your gates Praise" (60:18).
"The sun shall be no more your light by day, nor for brightness shall the moon give you light; but il SIGNORE will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your glory" (60:19).
"Your sun shall no more go down, nor your moon withdraw itself; for il SIGNORE will be your everlasting light, and your days of mourning shall be ended" (60:20).

stories.title: 🌅 Isaia 61
summaryBullets: Lo Spirito del Signore Dio è su di me, perché il Signore mi ha unto per recare una buona notizia agli umili; mi ha inviato per fasciare quelli che hanno il cuore spezzato, per proclamare la libertà a quelli che sono schiavi, l’apertura del carcere ai prigionieri, (61:1).
"To proclaim the year of il SIGNORE's favor, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all who mourn" (61:2).

"To grant to those who mourn in Zion—to give them a beautiful headdress instead of ashes, the oil of gladness instead of mourning, the garment of praise instead of a faint spirit; that they may be called oaks of righteousness, the planting of il SIGNORE, that He may be glorified" (61:3).
They shall build up the ancient ruins; they shall raise up the former devastations; they shall repair the ruined cities, the devastations of many generations (61:4).
Strangers shall stand and tend your flocks; foreigners shall be your plowmen and vinedressers (61:5).
Ma voi sarete chiamati sacerdoti del Signore, la gente vi chiamerà ministri del nostro Dio; voi mangerete le ricchezze delle nazioni, a voi toccherà la loro gloria. (61:6).

Instead of your shame there shall be a double portion; instead of dishonor they shall rejoice in their lot; therefore in their land they shall possess a double portion; they shall have everlasting joy (61:7).
For I il SIGNORE love justice; I hate robbery and wrong; I will faithfully give them their recompense, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them (61:8).
La loro razza sarà conosciuta fra le nazioni, la loro discendenza fra i popoli; tutti quelli che li vedranno riconosceranno che sono una razza benedetta dal Signore. (61:9).

Io mi rallegrerò grandemente nel Signore, l’anima mia esulterà nel mio Dio; poiché egli mi ha rivestito delle vesti della salvezza, mi ha avvolto nel mantello della giustizia, come uno sposo che si adorna di un diadema, come una sposa che si adorna dei suoi gioielli. (61:10).
For as the earth brings forth its sprouts, and as a garden causes what is sown in it to sprout up, so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to sprout up before all the nations (61:11).

stories.title: 🌅 Isaia 62
summaryBullets: For Zion's sake I will not keep silent, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not be quiet, until her righteousness goes forth as brightness, and her salvation as a burning torch (62:1).
The nations shall see your righteousness, and all the kings your glory, and you shall be called by a new name that the mouth of il SIGNORE will give (62:2).
sarai una splendida corona in mano al Signore, un turbante regale nel palmo del tuo Dio. (62:3).

Non sarai più chiamata “Abbandonata”, la tua terra non sarà più detta “Desolazione”, ma tu sarai chiamata “La mia delizia è in lei”, e la tua terra “Maritata”; poiché il Signore si compiacerà in te, la tua terra avrà uno sposo. (62:4).
For as a young man marries a young woman, so shall your sons marry you, and as the bridegroom rejoices over the bride, so shall your God rejoice over you (62:5).
On your walls, O Jerusalem, I have set watchmen; all the day and all the night they shall never be silent. You who put il SIGNORE in remembrance, take no rest (62:6).
And give Him no rest until He establishes Jerusalem and makes it a praise in the earth (62:7).
The LORD has sworn by His right hand and by His mighty arm: "I will not again give your grain to be food for your enemies, and foreigners shall not drink your wine for which you have labored" (62:8).
But those who garner it shall eat it and praise il SIGNORE, and those who gather it shall drink it in the courts of My sanctuary (62:9).
Go through, go through the gates; prepare the way for the people; build up, build up the highway; clear it of stones; lift up a signal over the peoples (62:10).

Ecco, il Signore proclama fino agli estremi confini della terra: «Dite alla figlia di Sion: “Ecco, la tua salvezza giunge; ecco, egli ha con sé il suo salario, la sua retribuzione lo precede”». (62:11).
Quelli saranno chiamati «Popolo santo», «Redenti del Signore», e tu sarai chiamata «Ricercata», «Città non abbandonata». (62:12).

stories.title: 🩸 Isaia 63
summaryBullets: "Who is this who comes from Edom, in crimsoned garments from Bozrah, He who is splendid in His apparel, marching in the greatness of His strength?" "It is I, speaking in righteousness, mighty to save" (63:1).
"Why is Your apparel red, and Your garments like his who treads in the winepress?" (63:2).

"I have trodden the winepress alone, and from the peoples no one was with Me; I trod them in My anger and trampled them in My wrath; their lifeblood spattered on My garments, and stained all My apparel" (63:3).
"For the day of vengeance was in My heart, and My year of redemption had come" (63:4).
Io guardai, ma non c’era chi mi aiutasse; fui stupito che nessuno mi sostenesse; allora il mio braccio mi ha salvato e il mio furore mi ha sostenuto. (63:5).
"I trampled down the peoples in My anger; I made them drunk in My wrath, and I poured out their lifeblood on the earth" (63:6).

Io voglio ricordare le bontà del Signore, le lodi del Signore, considerando tutto quello che il Signore ci ha elargito; ricorderò il gran bene che ha fatto alla casa d’Israele, secondo la sua misericordia e secondo l’abbondanza della sua bontà. (63:7).
For He said, "Surely they are My people, children who will not deal falsely." And He became their Savior (63:8).

in tutte le loro angosce. Non fu un inviato, né un angelo, ma lui stesso a salvarli; nel suo amore e nella sua benevolenza egli li redense; se li prese sulle spalle e li portò tutti i giorni del passato; (63:9).
But they rebelled and grieved His Holy Spirit; therefore He turned to be their enemy, and Himself fought against them (63:10).
Allora il suo popolo si ricordò dei giorni antichi di Mosè. Dov’è colui che li fece uscire dal mare con il pastore del suo gregge? Dov’è colui che mise in mezzo a loro lo Spirito suo santo, (63:11).
Who caused His glorious arm to go at the right hand of Moses, who divided the waters before them to make for Himself an everlasting name (63:12).
Who led them through the depths? Like a horse in the desert, they did not stumble (63:13).
Like livestock that go down into the valley, the Spirit of il SIGNORE gave them rest. So You led Your people, to make for Yourself a glorious name (63:14).
Look down from heaven and see, from Your holy and beautiful habitation. Where are Your zeal and Your might? The stirring of Your inner parts and Your compassion are held back from me (63:15).
For You are our Father, though Abraham does not know us, and Israel does not acknowledge us; You, O LORD, are our Father, our Redeemer from of old is Your name (63:16).
O LORD, why do You make us wander from Your ways and harden our heart, so that we fear You not? Return for the sake of Your servants, the tribes of Your heritage (63:17).
Your holy people held possession for a little while; our adversaries have trampled down Your sanctuary (63:18).
We have become like those over whom You have never ruled, like those who are not called by Your name (63:19).

stories.title: 🩸 Isaia 64
summaryBullets: Oh that You would rend the heavens and come down, that the mountains might quake at Your presence (64:1).
As when fire kindles brushwood and the fire causes water to boil—to make Your name known to Your adversaries, and that the nations might tremble at Your presence! (64:2).
When You did awesome things that we did not look for, You came down, the mountains quaked at Your presence (64:3).
From of old no one has heard or perceived by the ear, no eye has seen a God besides You, who acts for those who wait for Him (64:4).
You meet him who joyfully works righteousness, those who remember You in Your ways. Behold, You were angry, and we sinned; in our sins we have been a long time, and shall we be saved? (64:5).
We have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteous deeds are like a polluted garment. We all fade like a leaf, and our iniquities, like the wind, take us away (64:6).
There is no one who calls upon Your name, who rouses himself to take hold of You; for You have hidden Your face from us, and have made us melt in the hand of our iniquities (64:7).
But now, O LORD, You are our Father; we are the clay, and You are our potter; we are all the work of Your hand (64:8).
Be not so terribly angry, O LORD, and remember not iniquity forever. Behold, please look, we are all Your people (64:9).
Your holy cities have become a wilderness; Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation (64:10).
Our holy and beautiful house, where our fathers praised You, has been burned by fire, and all our pleasant places have become ruins (64:11).
Will You restrain Yourself at these things, O LORD? Will You keep silent, and afflict us so terribly? (64:12).

stories.title: 🌍 Isaia 65
summaryBullets: "I was ready to be sought by those who did not ask for Me; I was ready to be found by those who did not seek Me. I said, 'Here I am, here I am,' to a nation that was not called by My name" (65:1).
"I spread out My hands all the day to a rebellious people, who walk in a way that is not good, following their own devices" (65:2).
"A people who provoke Me to My face continually, sacrificing in gardens and making offerings on bricks" (65:3).
"Who sit in tombs, and spend the night in secret places; who eat pig's flesh, and broth of tainted meat is in their vessels" (65:4).
"Who say, 'Keep to yourself, do not come near me, for I am too holy for you.' These are a smoke in My nostrils, a fire that burns all the day" (65:5).
"Behold, it is written before Me: 'I will not keep silent, but I will repay; I will indeed repay into their lap'" (65:6).

"Both your iniquities and your fathers' iniquities together," says il SIGNORE; "because they made offerings on the mountains and insulted Me on the hills, I will measure into their lap payment for their former deeds" (65:7).
Thus says il SIGNORE: "As the new wine is found in the cluster, and they say, 'Do not destroy it, for there is a blessing in it,' so I will do for My servants' sake, and not destroy them all" (65:8).
"I will bring forth offspring from Jacob, and from Judah possessors of My mountains; My chosen shall possess it, and My servants shall dwell there" (65:9).
"Sharon shall become a pasture for flocks, and the Valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down, for My people who have sought Me" (65:10).
"But you who forsake il SIGNORE, who forget My holy mountain, who set a table for Fortune and fill cups of mixed wine for Destiny" (65:11).

io vi destino alla spada e vi piegherete tutti per essere scannati; poiché io ho chiamato e voi non avete risposto; ho parlato e voi non avete dato ascolto; ma avete fatto ciò che è male ai miei occhi e avete preferito ciò che mi dispiace». (65:12).
Perciò così parla il Signore, Dio: «Ecco, i miei servi mangeranno, ma voi avrete fame; ecco, i miei servi berranno, ma voi avrete sete; ecco, i miei servi gioiranno, ma voi sarete delusi; (65:13).
"Behold, My servants shall sing for gladness of heart, but you shall cry out for pain of heart and shall wail for breaking of spirit" (65:14).
Lascerete il vostro nome come una imprecazione fra i miei eletti: “Il Signore, Dio, ti faccia morire!” Ma egli darà ai suoi servi un altro nome, (65:15).

in modo che chi si augurerà di essere benedetto nel paese, lo farà per il Dio di verità, e colui che giurerà nel paese, lo farà per il Dio di verità; perché le afflizioni di prima saranno dimenticate, saranno nascoste ai miei occhi. (65:16).
"For behold, I create new heavens and a new earth, and the former things shall not be remembered or come into mind" (65:17).
"But be glad and rejoice forever in that which I create; for behold, I create Jerusalem to be a joy, and her people to be a gladness" (65:18).
Io esulterò a motivo di Gerusalemme e gioirò del mio popolo; là non si udranno più voci di pianto né grida d’angoscia; (65:19).

non ci sarà più, in avvenire, bimbo nato per pochi giorni, né vecchio che non compia il numero dei suoi anni; chi morirà a cent’anni morirà giovane e il peccatore sarà colpito dalla maledizione a cent’anni. (65:20).
"They shall build houses and inhabit them; they shall plant vineyards and eat their fruit" (65:21).

"They shall not build and another inhabit; they shall not plant and another eat; for like the days of a tree shall the days of My people be, and My chosen shall long enjoy the work of their hands" (65:22).
Non si affaticheranno invano, non avranno più figli per vederli morire all’improvviso; poiché saranno la discendenza dei benedetti del Signore e i loro rampolli staranno con essi. (65:23).
"Before they call I will answer; while they are yet speaking I will hear" (65:24).

Il lupo e l’agnello pascoleranno assieme, il leone mangerà il foraggio come il bue, e il serpente si nutrirà di polvere. Non si farà né male né danno su tutto il mio monte santo», dice il Signore. (65:25).

stories.title: 🌍 Isaia 66
summaryBullets: Così parla il Signore: «Il cielo è il mio trono e la terra è lo sgabello dei miei piedi; quale casa potreste costruirmi? Quale potrebbe essere il luogo del mio riposo? (66:1).

"All these things My hand has made, and so all these things came to be," declares il SIGNORE. "But this is the one to whom I will look: he who is humble and contrite in spirit and trembles at My word" (66:2).

"He who slaughters an ox is like one who kills a man; he who sacrifices a lamb, like one who breaks a dog's neck; he who presents a offerta di cereali, like one who offers pig's blood; he who makes a memorial offering of frankincense, like one who blesses an idol. These have chosen their own ways, and their soul delights in their abominations" (66:3).

"I also will choose harsh treatment for them and bring their fears upon them, because when I called, no one answered, when I spoke, they did not listen; but they did what was evil in My eyes and chose that in which I did not delight" (66:4).

Ascoltate la parola del Signore, voi che tremate alla sua parola. «I vostri fratelli, che vi odiano e vi scacciano a causa del mio nome, dicono: “Si mostri il Signore nella sua gloria, affinché possiamo vedere la vostra gioia!” Ma essi saranno svergognati. (66:5).
Uno strepito esce dalla città, un clamore viene dal tempio. È la voce del Signore, che dà la retribuzione ai suoi nemici. (66:6).
"Before she was in labor she gave birth; before her pain came upon her she delivered a son" (66:7).

"Who has heard such a thing? Who has seen such things? Shall a land be born in one day? Shall a nation be brought forth in one moment? For as soon as Zion was in labor she brought forth her children" (66:8).
"Shall I bring to the point of birth and not cause to bring forth?" says il SIGNORE; "shall I, who cause to bring forth, shut the womb?" says your God (66:9).
"Rejoice with Jerusalem, and be glad for her, all you who love her; rejoice with her in joy, all you who mourn over her" (66:10).
"That you may nurse and be satisfied from her consoling breast; that you may drink deeply with delight from her glorious abundance" (66:11).

Poiché così parla il Signore: «Ecco, io dirigerò la pace verso di lei come un fiume, la ricchezza delle nazioni come un torrente che straripa, e voi sarete allattati, sarete portati in braccio, accarezzati sulle ginocchia. (66:12).
"As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you; you shall be comforted in Jerusalem" (66:13).

Voi lo vedrete, e il vostro cuore gioirà, le vostre ossa, come l’erba, riprenderanno vigore; la mano del Signore si farà conoscere in favore dei suoi servi, e la sua indignazione contro i suoi nemici. (66:14).
"For behold, il SIGNORE will come in fire, and His chariots like the whirlwind, to render His anger in fury, and His rebuke with flames of fire" (66:15).
"For by fire will il SIGNORE enter into judgment, and by His sword, with all flesh; and those slain by il SIGNORE shall be many" (66:16).

«Quelli che si santificano e si purificano per andare nei giardini dietro all’idolo che è là in mezzo, quelli che mangiano carne di porco, cose abominevoli e topi, saranno tutti consumati», dice il Signore. (66:17).
"For I know their works and their thoughts, and the time is coming to gather all nations and tongues. And they shall come and shall see My glory" (66:18).

Io metterò un segnale tra di loro e manderò alcuni dei loro scampati alle nazioni, a Tarsis, a Pul e a Lud che tirano d’arco, a Tubal e a Iavan, alle isole lontane che non hanno mai udito la mia fama e non hanno mai visto la mia gloria; essi proclameranno la mia gloria tra le nazioni. (66:19).

"And they shall bring all your brothers from all the nations as an offering to il SIGNORE, on horses and in chariots and in litters and on mules and on dromedaries, to My holy mountain Jerusalem," says il SIGNORE, "just as the Israelites bring their offerta di cereali in a clean vessel to the house of il SIGNORE" (66:20).
"And some of them also I will take for priests and for Levites," says il SIGNORE (66:21).
"For as the new heavens and the new earth that I make shall remain before Me," says il SIGNORE, "so shall your offspring and your name remain" (66:22).
"From new moon to new moon, and from Sabbath to Sabbath, all flesh shall come to worship before Me," declares il SIGNORE (66:23).

«Quando gli adoratori usciranno, vedranno i cadaveri degli uomini che si sono ribellati a me; poiché il loro verme non morirà e il loro fuoco non si estinguerà, e saranno in orrore a ogni carne». (66:24).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: שָׁחָה (shachah)
translationNotes.note: Prostrarsi o inchinarsi in umiltà. Usato per la riverenza verso Dio (Genesi 22:5; Esodo 4:31; Salmi 95:6; Isaia 66:23) ma anche per re o angeli. Molto fisico e centrato sulla postura.

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: נֶכֶה־רוּחַ / חָרֵד עַל דְּבָרִי — Greek (LXX): ταπεινὸς τῷ πνεύματι / τρέμων τοὺς λόγους — Aramaic: מְכִיךְ רוּחָא / דְּחֵיל מִן פִּתְגָמִי
translationNotes.note: La postura di adorazione scelta da Dio (66:2-5).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: תּוֹלָעָתָם לֹא תָמוּת… אֵשָׁם לֹא תִכְבֶּה — Greek (LXX): ὁ σκώληξ οὐ τελευτᾷ… τὸ πῦρ οὐ σβέννυται — Aramaic: תַּלְעָא לָא מֵית… נוּרָא לָא דָעֵךְ
translationNotes.note: Segno perpetuo di giudizio contro la ribellione persistente (66:24).

stories.keyTakeaway: Dio crea un mondo rinnovato per i Suoi umili servitori, rigetta la religione falsa, raduna adoratori da tutte le nazioni e lascia un segno eterno contro la ribellione.
